description:
A corrected successor deck retells the repository-materialization story with every falsifiable claim traced to a repository artifact, and the predecessor deck is archived behind a tombstone.

## Background

The adversarial audit in `dev/studies/cdc840ad-audit-2026-07-23.md` found nine falsifiable errors in the predecessor showcase deck (`dev/presentations/cdc840ad/talk.html`): a fabricated `fn derive(...)` signature, a non-existent "inspectable" plan JSON document, a "130 session opens" figure that is a 65-issue in-memory model prediction rather than a measurement of this repository, an "independent holistic PASS" that was written by the same agent that built the epic, a `RepositoryImage` struct with a field it does not have, and a diffstat row that reproduces under no stated path filter. It also found the deck loads reveal.js, KaTeX, and three font families from CDNs and cannot present air-gapped, while carrying KaTeX that no slide uses.

The successor deck lives at `dev/presentations/1cc809de/` and re-derives its figures from the performance artifacts and the final tree; every timing cites artifact path, command name, and stat. It carries an explicit correction inventory keyed by audit finding id (A1-1..A1-6, the A2 claims it retells, and A4-1..A4-3), mapping each to its corrected claim and evidence. It ships without KaTeX and with reveal.js and fonts vendored under the deck folder so it presents air-gapped. The predecessor deck moves to `dev/archive/features/cdc840ad/showcase`, leaving a tombstone at the original path that points to the successor deck and the audit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-16: A corrected successor presentation of the repository-materialization story exists in which every falsifiable claim traces to a repository artifact, and the predecessor deck is archived with a tombstone pointing to the successor and the audit.

## Notes

This deck is a corrected retelling of the predecessor story, not a deck about this epic's own work. Asset vendoring is pinned by plan decision PD-2: reveal.js and fonts are vendored locally and KaTeX is dropped, so rendering is reproducible from the repository alone. The successor must pass the presentation fit checker across all slides.
title: Replace the repository-materialization showcase with a corrected successor
